global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible chashu pork and menma arranged atop. The bowl, with blue floral trim, sits on a wooden table under warm light, enhancing the dish’s inviting, savory appearance.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern and green speckles along the rim, smooth surface with slight gloss.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green herbs, red chili oil, and sliced scallions, appears rich and textured.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is browned, tender-looking, and topped with green garnish, appearing succulent and slightly curled.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, sliced, slightly curved pieces with visible fibrous texture and greenish-brown seasoning.
